awakening_system.screen.guide.system.tex: • Earn experience by mining ores, defeating creatures, and completing quests.
• Each level grants Attribute Points to forge your unique specialization.
• Vitality (Max health & regeneration) | Perception (Luck & critical hit)
• Chain 10 consecutive strikes without taking damage to enter §6Trance Mode§f.
• In Trance you gain §a+35% Damage§f, sonic movement speed, and overload particles.
• Upon reaching Level 30 you unlock your specialization: Hunter, Assassin, Mage, or Necromancer.
• Right-click while holding Awakening Coins to deposit them into your virtual balance instantly.
• Use the 'BANK' tab in the Shop to deposit or withdraw physical coin bundles.
awakening_system.screen.guide.ranks.head: §6§l[FULL SYSTEM RANK SCALE (41 RANKS)]
awakening_system.screen.guide.ranks.text: • Human Elite: EX (70) -> SS (90) -> SSS (110) -> §6National (130)§f [Mortal Peak]
• Deities: Supreme Being (350) -> Demigod (370) -> God (400) -> Deity (430) -> Ancestral (460)
• Absolute: Infinite (610) -> Omnipotent (640) -> Absolute Being (670) -> Absolute (700)
• Creation: Supreme Creator (730) -> Absolute Creator (760) -> Chaos Sovereign (800)
• Final Deities: Timeless Monarch (840) -> Astral Deity (880) -> Singularity (920)
• §6Limitless (960) -> ABSOLUTE GOD (1000)§f [Supreme Entity of the Multiverse]
awakening_system.screen.guide.ranks.head: §b§l[PORTAL COLOR CODING]
awakening_system.screen.guide.ranks.text: • §bCyan:§f Ranks E/D | §aGreen:§f C/B | §6Amber:§f A | §cCrimson:§f S | §5Purple:§f SS to National
• §dOrchid:§f Monarchs | §eCelestial Gold:§f Deities (370+) | §4Red Gates:§f Extreme dungeons
awakening_system.screen.guide.dungeons.t: • Dungeons are seamless complexes connected through 4 Magical Barrier Walls:
1. §fAbyssal Antechamber:§7 Sunken central pit with frontline vanguard enemies.
2. §fCrypt Passageway:§7 Gothic colonnades, iron barred cells, and lurking assassins.
3. §fWar & Magma Pit:§7 Sunken circular crucible, elevated catwalks, and Mini-Boss.
4. §fCathedral Nave:§7 12-block high vaulted ceiling with buttresses and necromancers.
5. §6Imperial Throne Hall:§e 3-tiered dais hosting the Supreme Boss (Igris / Baran).
• To dissolve a wall you must eliminate all enemies in the current stage.
• Each cleared wall grants extra time to the collapse timer.
• Defeating the Monarch in Stage 5 manifests the Roulette Altar for your loot. Return to Room 1 to cross the exit gate.
awakening_system.screen.guide.skills.tex: • Only one player per world/server can hold each unique distinction:
2. §bDemon King of Salvation:§f Fourth Wall: Infinite (Massive heal & immunity).
4. §cDragon Emperor:§f Cosmic Dragon Breath (Total destructive beam).
• Slay enemies and extract their souls to build your imperial shadow army.
• §bAllied Immunity:§f Your shadow soldiers are completely immune to your own attacks.
• §bAuto-Teleport:§f If they stray farther than 16 blocks, they blink right behind you.
• Raise any skill to Level 10 to unlock its evolved form.
awakening_system.screen.guide.tower.head: §6§l[1. TOWER OF RANKERS (100 FLOORS)]
awakening_system.screen.guide.tower.text: • Ascend through all 100 floors using a Tower Ticket or /system tower.
awakening_system.screen.guide.tower.head: §e§l[2. SEALED CHAMBERS & SCALED THREATS]
awakening_system.screen.guide.tower.text: • Each floor is an enclosed chamber with ceiling, 4 structural pillars, and tier-themed walls.
• Enemy HP, attack damage, and armor scale strictly with floor level.
awakening_system.screen.guide.tower.head: §b§l[3. SHINSOO PORTALS & CHECKPOINTS]
awakening_system.screen.guide.tower.text: • Defeating all monsters unlocks the Shinsoo Ascension Portal to climb higher.
• The south exit portal and Return Scrolls preserve your highest checkpoint upon returning home.
awakening_system.screen.guide.tower.head: §d§l[4. PINNACLE (FLOOR 100) & ISEKAI PORTAL]
awakening_system.screen.guide.tower.text: • Awaiting on Floor 100 is the Grand Tower Administrator (6,500 HP) and Divine Guardians.
• Defeating him opens the Great Isekai Portal: System 2.0 Update and massive Constellation sponsorship.
awakening_system.screen.guide.cultivatio: • Qi is separate from Mana. It does not regenerate passively or with potions: only by cultivating.
• Press [C] or /system cultivate to assume the lotus position and gather celestial Qi.
• 5 Realms: Qi Condensation -> Foundation Establishment -> Golden Core -> Nascent Soul -> Celestial Ascension.
• 9 Sub-levels per realm. Advancing resets Qi to 0 and increases passive gathering rate (+1 Qi/s per sub-level).
• Unlock meridians using Qi to boost speed, passive regeneration, damage, and break through bottlenecks.
• Lethal spiritual combat blade (+12 Damage). Right-click to mount and fly in 3D space.
• Look-directed control: press [W] to fly where you look. [Shift] to dismount, Sneak+Right-Click to retrieve it.
awakening_system.screen.guide.sponsors.t: • You are an Incarnation in the Star Stream. Constellations closely watch your trials.
• §bAny constellation§f can spontaneously donate Coins when witnessing legendary feats.
• When leveling up or clearing dungeons, you can open §eSponsor Selection§f.
• Signing with an Official Sponsor grants their exclusive §aStigma and Attributes§f.
• §dOther constellations will still donate and send messages like in the webtoon!§f
• §ePrisoner of the Golden Headband (Sun Wukong):§f +Strength, Jump Boost & Willpower.
• §8Abyssal Black Flame Dragon:§f +Attack Damage & Knockback Resistance.
• §fDemon-like Judge of Fire (Uriel):§f +Max Health & Holy Judgment.
• §bDemon King of Salvation (Kim Dokja):§f +Max Health, Defense & Intelligence.
